gallery.label: Kick-up with the smoothness cost alone: gives up and crouches rather than commit
Kick-up under the old constant-damping servo: arrives, then rings for a second and a half
Kick-up with inertia-scaled damping and a braked approach: arrival is clean, but it hyperextends a knee 37 degrees, because range of motion was only a fine
Kick-up as it stands: recreational strength, bounded entry, anatomy priced properly
The same kick-up handed a press-capable shoulder (2.8 Nm/kg): it spends the strength leaning back out over the hands
Press on the default body (shoulder 1.6 Nm/kg): the best attempt still collapses
Press at shoulder 2.2 Nm/kg: still not enough
Press at shoulder 2.8 Nm/kg with ordinary hamstrings: works
Press at shoulder 2.8 Nm/kg with hamstrings to 125 degrees: the same skill for 2.5x less

Bent-leg press attempt from the old start, balanced over the palms with nothing on the legs: with nothing to push off, the search holds a tucked fold for a second and a half, sets both feet back down on the floor, and jumps
Bent-leg press before the shape was scored: it hops, but rises through a tucked planche with one leg straight and the other folded, which is cheap and is not the skill
Bent-leg press at 2.0 Nm/kg: a hop off both feet into a fully inverted tuck, then the legs extend overhead together
